thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: us-west inference-gateway elevated 5xx/timeouts detected. 5m error rate 8% (baseline 0.4%). spikes align with KV/prefix-cache eviction rate and prefix-miss ratio. dashboard: https://dash.board/redwood/alerts/3411122333

oncall_sam: I'm on it. Paging SRE. taking incident lead. pinging @eng-maya and @ops-raja for prefix cache deep-dive.

jessika: saw this hit our customer probe checks ~2m ago, Uptime SLOs failing for a handful of customers in us-west. collecting impacted list now.

eng-maya: quick signal: recent rollout of `prefix-eviction-v2` (12:40 UTC) increased aggressive eviction thresholds. Could be thrashing hot shards -> backend timeouts. Reverting that rollout is my first try.

ops-raja: running quick health checks on KV layer, streaming logs now.

infra-bot: KV shard metrics: eviction_count(us-west-1) = 2.3k/min (normally 110/min); prefix_miss_rate = 67% -> elevated load on origin stores.

ops-raja: logs from kv-proxy-03 (tail):
```
[3411122333.12] ERROR prefix_cache.go:243 evicting shard shard-17: eviction loop x1000, free_mem_low
[3411122333.45] WARN proxy.go:89 backend timeout to store-17: context deadline exceeded
[3411122340.01] INFO io.go: read latency spike: 1200ms
```

oncall_sam: plan: 1) set prefix-cache bypass on gateway to force reads to origin for a small ring 2) roll back `prefix-eviction-v2` 3) rate-limit client retries 4) if still failing, scale kv-read pool. executing step 1 now.

eng-maya: to bypass ring `usw1-a` run:
```bash
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/inference-gateway CACHE_PREFIX_BYPASS=usw1-a
# or via infra API
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://infra.api/env -d '{"CACHE_PREFIX_BYPASS":"usw1-a"}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: inference-gateway env update requested by oncall_sam. rollout started.

pm-lena: heads-up to product / CS: we're actively mitigating. please hold customer comms until we have impact numbers.

cs-tom: getting pings from three enterprise customers (acme, nova, finco) reporting timeouts ~12:45 UTC. collecting error traces now.

ops-raja: after bypass toggle, observing immediate drop in prefix_miss_rate for ring `usw1-a` from 67% -> 12% but overall 5xx still at 3.4% (was 8%). looks like partial mitigation.

jessika: forwarding initial affected customers list: acme, nova, finco. severity: degraded UX, but no data loss.

eng-maya: rolling back `prefix-eviction-v2` now (k8s rollout restart for kv-controller):
```bash
kubectl -n kv rollout undo deployment/kv-controller --to-revision=23
kubectl -n kv rollout status deployment/kv-controller
```

infra-bot: rollback acknowledged. kv-controller rev -> 23. starting controlled ramp.

ops-raja: watching eviction_count: dropping from 2.3k/min -> 180/min over next 45s. backend timeouts decreasing.

oncall_sam: can we add a temporary circuit-breaker on gateway to queue requests instead of forwarding to overloaded stores? that should reduce 502 cascades.

eng-maya: yes, enabling `backpressure_mode=queue` for `/generate` route for 2m to stabilize.

oncall_sam: applied backpressure for `/generate` at 12:52 UTC. 5xx trending down to 0.9% in 3m window.

pm-lena: customer notes: Acme reported high latency and retries causing duplicate invoice submissions. Need to offer rollback window and incident PR as soon as we stabilize.

cs-tom: Acme support ticket created (INC-8271), severity P2. I added mitigation notes and temporary workaround (use smaller batch sizes).

eng-maya: root-cause hypothesis: `prefix-eviction-v2` change reduced per-prefix memory allocation; hot prefixes started thrashing causing mass evictions, leading to origin surge and timeouts -> gateway 5xx. Also TTL desync between kv-nodes caused unnecessary evictions.

ops-raja: found TTL expiration jitter on shard-17: two nodes had clocks skewed ~4s causing conflicting eviction heuristics. investigating NTP drift.

infra-bot: NTP drift alert on kv-node-17b: offset=4.2s. auto-correction scheduled.

jessika: any planned next steps before declaring mitigated?

oncall_sam: next steps: a) keep `prefix-cache` bypass for 30m while rollback settles b) monitor eviction_count and 5xx c) coordinate formal postmortem and assign owners for TTL sync + rollout gating d) audit rollout checks to include per-shard eviction simulation.

eng-maya: assigning tasks: TTL sync fix -> ops-raja; rollout-gate checklist -> eng-maya; postmortem -> oncall_sam + jessika.

ops-raja: I pushed a quick NTP fix to the node pool and restarted kv-agent on affected hosts.

infra-bot: metrics snapshot 12:58 UTC: 5xx=0.4% (baseline 0.3%), eviction_count=95/min, prefix_miss=9%.

pm-lena: started drafting customer communication for impacted accounts. will share with CS for approval.

cs-tom: Acme confirmed improved response times on our side. They still have retries to clean up client-side but are no longer blocked.

eng-maya: marking impact reduced. will keep the bypass on until tomorrow morning 06:00 UTC when we plan a controlled re-enable with additional guardrails.

oncall_sam: incident summary: elevated 5xx/timeouts in us-west caused by eviction storm after recent `prefix-eviction-v2` rollout + TTL drift. mitigation: rollback rollout, enable gateway bypass for ring, enable request backpressure, NTP/TTL fixes. customer impact: multiple enterprise accounts experienced high latency/timeouts, no data loss. owner list created for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident #IR-2026 assigned, severity P2 -> status: mitigated, runbook: /incidents/IR-2026/postmortem

oncall_sam: thanks everyone. handing off to oncall follow-up team. I'll update incident doc and close from pager after 1h of stable metrics. :thumbsup:
